lines.say: In two thousand eight, Starbucks closed about seven thousand stores for an afternoon.
A hundred and thirty-five thousand employees got retrained on how to pull a good shot.
No ads. They fixed things for the people who were already walking in.
caps: They fixed it for *people already coming.*

lines.say: Regulars notice when something slips, and most of them never say a word. They just stop showing up.
So ask them. One text tells you what guessing never will.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
